title: Elegant Smokey Vietnamese Rice Pho
description: A comforting Vietnamese noodle soup made with smoked flavors and pillowy rice noodles. This version is satvik-friendly and perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Combine pork bones and vegetable broth in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to 180°F and simmer for 2 hours.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté sliced ginger and minced garlic until fragrant.
Add rice noodles to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve and discard the solids.
Add furikake to the broth and stir to combine.
To assemble the pho, place cooked noodles in a bowl, then add sliced radish, bean sprouts, and chopped cilantro.
Pour hot broth over the top and serve with a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
